vars.prTitle: Access control: reject malformed scopes in external service role registration
vars.prBody: External services (plugins with an `iam` section) can request permissions with malformed scopes such as `users:*:1`. Those are accepted today and silently never match at evaluation time. SaveExternalServiceRoleCommand.Validate now rejects them with a clear error. Added a test case.
vars.goldenComments: [{"comment": "The new check calls ValidateScope on every requested permission, but ValidateScope (pkg/services/accesscontrol/accesscontrol.go:319) indexes `scope[:len(scope)-1], scope[len(scope)-1]` unconditionally and panics with an index out of range on an empty scope. Scopeless permissions are legitimate: plugin IAM permissions have an optional `scope` (pkg/plugins/auth/models.go Scope string, plugin.schema.json does not require it), Reduce handles Scope == \"\" explicitly, and the only existing caller, match() in evaluator.go, guards `if scope == \"\" { return false }` before calling ValidateScope. So any plugin that registers an action without a scope now makes SaveExternalServiceRole (acimpl/service.go:721, called from extsvcaccounts.ManageExtSvcAccount) panic during plugin registration. The validation must skip empty scopes.", "severity": "High"}]
